summary: This CSS styles a small action group containing a copy button and a raw link. The wrapper uses flexbox with tight spacing (6px gap) to keep the unborderd 'raw' link visually grouped with its associated button, rather than floating between two bordered actions. Both elements share a small font size and get darker on hover.

explanations.12: inline-flex makes the wrapper sit inline with surrounding content while still using flexbox layout rules for its children.
explanations.14: The 6px gap is deliberately smaller than the parent row's 16px spacing — this visual tightness helps the borderless 'raw' link feel attached to the copy button.
explanations.32: The :not(:disabled) pseudo-class means the hover styles only apply when the button is clickable, preventing visual changes when it's disabled.
explanations.42: This hover state changes the 'raw' link to the primary color to indicate interactivity, since the link has no border of its own to signal it's clickable.
